config.name: armors.json
config.summary: Defines 172 armor sets for Voxel Blade. Each set has a name, shared stats (defense, elemental boosts, resistance), a unique perk with amount, and part descriptions (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings). Stats include physical/magic defense, elemental boosts (fire, water, earth, air, holy, hex), dexterity, summon boost, protection, warding, tenacity, jump/speed/attack speed boosts, and heat/cold resistance.

config.name: blades.json
config.summary: Defines 106 blade items (weapon heads) organized by tiers 1-5. Each blade has a name, tier, attack speed, damage type stats (physical, elemental scalings and boosts), optional perks, and a blade type (Small Blade, Medium Blade, Heavy Blade, Hammer Head). Tiers range from Basic (tier 1) to Starlight (tier 5).

config.name: enchantments.json
config.summary: Defines 51 enchantments split into two categories: 'unAscended' (26 base enchantments) and 'Ascended' (25 advanced enchantments). Each has a stacking rule (exclusive or multi), stat modifiers (multipliers/additions), optional effects with named abilities, and optional additional notes about acquisition conditions.

config.name: essences.json
config.summary: Defines 105 essence items organized by tiers 1-5. Essences are stat-modifying components that mirror blade designs. Each has a name, tier, attack speed, scaling stats, optional perks, and an essenceType (typically 'Essence', one 'Proto Essence'). Tiers range from Basic (tier 1) to Starlight (tier 5).

config.name: gloves.json
config.summary: Defines 22 glove items organized by tiers 1-4. Each glove has a name, tier, attack speed, damage type stats, perks (including unique Spirit perks for the Monk guild), and a gloveType (Gloves or Shield). Gloves are the Monk-class weapon type and always include a Spirit perk.

config.name: guilds.json
config.summary: Defines 9 character guilds, each with 3 ranks. Guilds provide stat bonuses and perks that scale with rank. Guilds include Gladiator, Cursed, Cleric, Scholar, Knight, Thief, Draconic, Monk, and Vampire. Each rank increases stat values and perk amounts.

config.name: handles.json
config.summary: Defines 103 handle items (weapon shafts) organized by tiers 1-5. Each handle has a name, tier, attack speed, scaling stats, optional perks, and a handleType (Medium Handle, Long Handle, or Pole). Tiers range from Basic (tier 1) to Starlight (tier 5). Many handles are paired with corresponding blades.

config.name: perks.json
config.summary: Defines 247+ unique perks (combat abilities and passive effects) with detailed descriptions and tag classifications. Tags categorize perks by source (Armor, Weapon, Ring, Guild, Enchantment), function (Offensive, Defensive, Buff, Debuff, Healing, etc.), and mechanics (RNG, Cooldown Reduction, Poison/Burn/Bleed Potency, etc.). This is the central reference file for all perk names used across equipment.

config.name: races.json
config.summary: Defines 10 playable races with unique passive abilities and stat modifiers. Races include Human, Half-Ork, Elf, Dark Elf, Dragon Blooded, Ork, High Elf, Arborian, Kitsune, and Bunikin. Each has a passive description and optional numeric stat/cooldown modifiers.

config.name: rings.json
config.summary: Defines 35 ring accessories, each providing stat boosts and a unique perk. Rings are equipment accessories that enhance specific playstyles. Each has a name, description, upgrade level, stat boosts, and a named perk with amount.

config.name: runes.json
config.summary: Defines 41 rune abilities (active skills) with stat boosts, cooldowns, and optional perk grants. Runes are activatable abilities with cooldowns ranging from 5 to 120 seconds. Each has a name, description, upgrade level, stat boosts, cooldown, and optional linked perk.

config.name: dot-damage.ts
config.summary: Damage over Time (DoT) constants: base damage, infliction divisor, potency power cap, rounding factor, and builder-to-game conversion rate.

config.name: draconic-colors.ts

config.name: draconic.ts
config.summary: Draconic infusion potency/duration multipliers, dragon state HP and multiplier values, and bastion blessing multiplier.

config.name: game.ts
config.summary: Core game constants: max/default level, HP defaults, timing constants (debounce, undo window, search blur delay), and calcBaseMaxHP function for computing base HP from level.

config.name: heals.ts
config.summary: Healing constants: crit healing base value, holy boost divisor, per-stack healing, and Ocean Song per-stack heal bonus.

config.name: rune-base-damage.ts
config.summary: Rune base damage values for active rune abilities: Ancient Cleric, Beenade, Boostshroom, Thunderous Charge, Sporeling Toss, Foot Dive, Caci, Cacitrops, Hex Web, Brainblast, Rocky Tail, and Slayer Rage.

config.name: stat-conversions.ts
config.summary: Stat boost conversion rates for perks that convert one stat to another: Weight Distribution, Quick Witted, Whirl Foot, Carapace, Frozen Heart, Immovable, Righted Wrongs, Rocky Body, Spellshield, Strong Tides, Swift Guard, True Balance, Rawny. Also includes stat subtraction constants.

config.name: thresholds.ts
config.summary: Gameplay threshold constants: armor penetration branch threshold (0.2), minimum cooldown (1), and base crit damage percentage (100).
